text:
Trachoma is an infection caused by an obligate intracellular bacterium,
Chlamydia trachomatis. The organism is found in the conjunctival as well as
corneal epithelium and is responsible for two different conditions:
- Trachoma (a severe disease)
- Inclusion conjunctivitis (milder)
Trachoma is commonly associated with poverty and unhygienic living
conditions.
